technical_merge_audit.rule: POST-HOC technical recovery: earliest complete serialized episode, profile then original partial then recovered/full; never select by outcome.

technical_sensitivities_POST_HOC.scope: Diagnostics fixed after parser recovery mismatch, before reading main effects; primary all-200 and seeds unchanged. Full-version sensitivity does not choose outcomes; graph exclusion is never primary.

episode_runtimes.timer_scope: Aborted before final timers; exact calls and complete episode records retained; slot original start-to-shutdown.

cost_runtimes_including_call_dependencie.timer_scope: Aborted before final timers; exact calls and complete episode records retained; slot original start-to-shutdown.

definitions.unit: Three seeds averaged within source graph; 4000 paired graph-bootstrap pointwise 95% intervals.
definitions.contrast_orientation: Backend is native_skill minus model_steps; trait is agreeable minus firm; interaction is the difference of backend contrasts.
definitions.successful_native_event: legal and executed and not stochastic_failure; exact initial source entity ID plus actual before/after effects.
definitions.npc_goal_bound_ever: Successful NPC event with the exact native event type and target IDs bound in the original source initial graph.
definitions.npc_goal_physical_ever: Bound source Give to authored recipient, exact wear/wield equipped mode by NPC, or actual NPC Eat/Drink/Ingest consumption of bound source.
definitions.equipment: Any successful Wear/Wield/Equip and final equipped mode are also reported separately. Generic equip mode is not silently equated to wear/wield.
definitions.ever_vs_final: Goal, NPC source Give, player Get/Steal, equipment/consumption are historical events; final direct and ultimate possession are separate. They may co-occur.
definitions.speech: Only successful native Say/Tell/Whisper events transmit utterance. Opening common request is excluded from the 8+8 action/count metrics.
definitions.skills: Only already selected two-primitive outcomes trigger the executor contrast. Every primitive uses one opportunity and the player may act between them.
definitions.triggered_subsets: Two-step choices and realized choices are post-treatment descriptions, not separate causal effect estimates or independent samples.
definitions.costs: All physically incurred calls in supplied distinct directories count once; identical profile/full/aborted episodes and repeated decision inputs are separately deduplicated. Aborted missing final timers remain null; observed slot duration is separately labeled.
definitions.technical_loader_revision: Added explicit archived ABORTED_NATIVE_HELP_DEPENDENCY_API inputs after a native Help/emoji API crash; after parser ambiguity disproved exact restoration, preserve earliest complete episodes (profile, partial, full) and audit nonexact duplicates; full-version and graph-exclusion diagnostics do not change primary N/endpoints/conditions/seeds/bootstrap.

scope: All source worlds and all configured seeds retained, including zero-player-asset worlds, rejected actions, deaths and protocol failures.
Both arms share a strong high-level outcome/native-action/speech selector. This is a closed-loop configuration comparison, not a raw-model-vs-scaffold contrast.
Model identity includes both NPC and simulated player; there are no human experience, private welfare, mutual benefit or full quest completion claims.
Original authored atomic goal and assigned player request can conflict; obtaining the item by player Get/Steal is not NPC voluntary compliance.
Already exposed same-engine worlds are not a new-world or human-player generalization test.
